questions.stem: A 42-year-old male presents to a dental clinic for a dental procedure. The dentist administers lignocaine to the patient and starts the procedure. The patient suddenly complains of headache, fatigue, breathlessness and chest discomfort. The dentist also noticed that blood oozing from his gums was chocolate brown, and the patient appeared cyanosed. What is the treatment in this case?
